title.zh: v2.18.0 26 个曲风的「黑胶爆豆声」改用真实采样；顺带修好两对几乎一模一样的曲风
title.en: v2.18.0 26 genres' vinyl crackle plays a real sample — and the recording it forced exposed two pairs of near-identical genres

highlights.zh: **唱针噪声不再是合成出来的。** 库里 26 个曲风（microhouse、trip-hop、boom-bap、lofi-hip-hop、爵士与布鲁斯各支、motown、neo-soul、samba 等）本来就声明了 `vinyl_crackle`——正是原生音色注释里写的「采样与虫胶唱片曲风」——所以这次不是给它们加新东西，而是那条轨终于播的是录音：GS-1 的采样档、一次性播放、根音 60，音色包络按「爆豆是一声轻响、不是一个和弦」来定。真录音是内容，目前播的是生成的替身（衰减噪声床 + 不均匀瞬态），有素材随时替换。
highlights.en: **Needle noise is no longer synthesised.** 26 genres already declared `vinyl_crackle` — microhouse, trip-hop, boom-bap, lofi-hip-hop, the jazz and blues genres, motown, neo-soul, samba — which is exactly the "sampled and shellac-recorded" set the native voice's own comment names. So nothing was added to them; the lane simply plays a recording now: GS-1's sample mode, one-shot, root 60, with an envelope chosen because a crackle is a tick rather than a chord. highlights.zh: **第一次诚实的全库音色指纹测量抓出两对几乎相同的曲风。** 提交在库里的指纹基线是 09-20 的（在那轮宽度/母带/逐音改动之前），而这个门禁是拿基线**内部**两两比较的——所以旧文件按构造就能通过，线下的声音早就漂了。重新录 159 首之后，最近的一对是 `french-house` ↔ `nu-disco-house` **0.1330 dB**（下限 0.25），而旧文件里是 0.6407：两个曲风声明了**完全相同的八件乐器**，此前只靠老混音里的差异撑着。修法是给它们各自的曲风该有的编制——nu-disco-house 用 m1 organ / pluck synth / fingerstyle bass，microhouse 用 punchy kick / finger_bass / vibraphone / bell_lead——现在这两对分别是 **1.1963 dB** 与 **0.4133 dB**。剩下的最近一对是 ambient-techno ↔ dub-techno 的 0.2774 dB：三个相邻风格本来就共用…
highlights.en: **The first honest full-library timbre recording caught two pairs of near-identical genres.** The committed fingerprint baseline was from 09-20 — before the width, master and per-note work — and the gate compares pairs *within* the baseline, so a stale file passes by construction while the shipped sound drifts underneath it. highlights.zh: **电平重录与曲线**：159 个曲风重新测过，10 条 trim 变动（26 条非零），天花板上限守住（最差 −1.23 dBTP），p90−p10 从 5.90 收到 **5.86 LU**。
highlights.en: **Levels re-recorded**: all 159 genres re-measured, 10 trims moved (26 non-zero), the ceiling held (worst −1.23 dBTP), and p90−p10 tightened from 5.90 to **5.86 LU**.
